method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stock futures move higher as traders await more inflation data
Equities.reason: Macro-led near-term bullish signal: futures up ahead of inflation prints suggests risk-on positioning if CPI stays tame. Relevance reflects direct market-regime transmission (inflation → equities).

Equities.title: US Stocks Rise on AI Trade as Market Awaits More Inflation Data
Equities.reason: Clear market-dominant narrative: AI-led tech rally driving broad gains while macro (inflation) risk awaits. High relevance because it encapsulates the primary equity catalyst (AI leadership + macro backdrop).

Equities.title: S&P 500 Closes Near Record High on Tame Inflation: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Market-regime confirmation: tame inflation supporting new highs for the broad market. Relevant to equities because it signals liquidity/valuation support across indices.

Equities.title: The latest rally has energized the stock market but left the credit market concerned
Equities.reason: Important cross-market warning: equity rally contrasts with credit-market stress — a downside risk to risk appetite and rally sustainability. Relevance elevated as credit cracks can precede wider market pain.

Equities.title: CoreWeave counters a key bear case on the AI trade. What it means for our data center stocks
Equities.summary: CoreWeave is seeing strong demand for six-year-old Nvidia chips, helping justify all the current AI capex.
Equities.reason: Direct bullish evidence for the AI-led equity narrative: stronger-than-expected demand for AI-capex supports the ‘AI supercycle’ trade. High relevance as it addresses a central bear case (capex/demand).

Equities.title: CoreWeave Stock Surge Gives the AI Trade a Boost
Equities.reason: Reinforces the AI-driven leadership theme: a notable data-center name rallying lifts sentiment for tech/AI cohort. Moderate relevance as a supportive datapoint rather than market-wide proof.

Equities.title: AI Cloud Provider Lambda Prices Loan for Nvidia-Tied Chip Deal
Equities.reason: Shows financing activity enabling AI capex — supportive for AI-equity names and chip demand. Balanced relevance because it signals both growth financing and potential leverage/credit transmission risks.

Equities.title: Wall Street giants bet Nvidia’s AI chips will defy the laws of finance
Equities.summary: Private capital firms are wagering that the crucial hardware will hold its value for years to come
Equities.reason: Valuation/structural risk signpost: highlights froth and idiosyncratic financing bets around Nvidia ecosystem — a bearish circuit-breaker for the AI narrative if proven wrong. Relevance elevated due to systemic leverage/valuation angle.

Equities.title: Anthropic investors bet on $2tn valuation in record IPO
Equities.summary: Rapid revenue growth fuels hope Claude maker can overcome challenges to become the biggest listing in history
Equities.reason: Sustains the AI-euphoria narrative: mega-IPO expectations amplify risk-on flows into AI/tech. Relevance medium-high because IPO scale can influence market sentiment and liquidity.

Equities.title: Korean Stocks Rise 22% in 10 Days as Chip Rally Regains Steam
Equities.reason: Regional confirmation of the chip/AI leadership theme: strong overseas chip performance supports global tech risk appetite and flows into semiconductors.

Equities.title: Oil prices continue climb on US-Iran deal doubts; stocks retreat
Equities.reason: Commodity-driven risk-off: rising oil on geopolitical uncertainty compresses equity multiples and weighs on cyclicals. Relevant as a clear downside trigger to market sentiment.

Equities.title: ‘Hormuz remains blocked’: Iran disputes Trump claims as traffic sinks to near 3-month lows
Equities.summary: The Persian Strait Gulf Authority said "the Strait of Hormuz remains blocked and will not be reopened until Iran's conditions are accepted."
Equities.reason: High-impact geopolitical risk: blockade of Strait of Hormuz elevates oil/energy risk premiums and broad market volatility. Relevance high given direct transmission to global risk sentiment and energy prices.

Equities.title: Ukraine attacks Russian grain export terminals in Black Sea, prompting warning about food markets
Equities.summary: Ukraine has launched a heavy drone assault on warships and major Russian grain export terminals in the Black Sea port city of Novorossiysk.
Equities.reason: Geopolitical shock with commodity and risk-off implications: threatens food/commodity supply chains and adds to market volatility; moderate relevance to equities.

Equities.title: U.S. budget deficit surged in July to highest level since March 2021
Equities.summary: Beyond the big single-month jump, the collective red ink over the 10 months of the fiscal year rose to nearly $1.8 trillion, surpassing the same period in 2025.
Equities.reason: Fiscal deterioration is a moderate negative for market backdrop (potential for higher issuance, longer-term rate pressure). Relevance limited to macro policy channel rather than immediate equity flows.

Equities.title: Trading Day: AI cheer, new highs near
Equities.reason: Concise market summary reinforcing AI-driven leadership and higher indices — representative of the prevailing positive market regime. Good relevance as succinct synthesis of drivers.

Equities.title: Lenovo Shares Surge 22% After Revenue Beat Renews AI Optimism
Equities.reason: Single-company result with broader signal: hardware revenue beat feeds AI optimism; included at lower relevance as it is a specific corporate datapoint supporting the wider AI narrative.

Rates.title: Treasurys in turmoil: What rising yields mean for your money
Rates.reason: Headline explicitly frames rising Treasury yields as the central theme — indicates a bond selloff/higher-for-longer rates impulse, negative for bond prices with material market impact.

Rates.title: Morning Bid: Fed bets cool, BOJ wagers heat up
Rates.reason: Notes cooling Fed rate-hike expectations (supporting lower US yields) versus a more hawkish BOJ — for US rates the dominant near-term tilt is toward easing Fed bets and lower yields, so modestly positive for bond prices.

Rates.title: Stocks Edge Higher as Fed Rate-Hike Bets Ease: Markets Wrap
Rates.reason: Market reaction piece linking equities gains to easing Fed hike bets and lower front-end yields — implies bond rally and lower rates risk, positive for bonds.

Rates.title: Markets Get Inflation Relief
Rates.reason: Headline frames inflation relief as the key market driver — translates into reduced Fed urgency and meaningful bond demand (yields down), a significant positive for rates (bond prices).

Rates.title: Consumer prices rose 0.1% in July, as expected, putting the annual rate at 3.4%
Rates.summary: The consumer price index was expected to increase 0.1% in July, with an annual rate of 3.4%.
Rates.reason: In-line/slowing CPI reduces near-term Fed hike urgency and supports lower US yields — positive for bond prices, but a routine CPI print so relevance is moderate.

Rates.title: Equities: AI rally and CPI relief lift US stocks – Deutsche Bank
Rates.summary: Deutsche Bank strategists highlight that the S&P 500 closed just below its record high as US CPI data reduced urgency for further Federal Reserve hikes. Front-end Treasuries rallied and semiconductor strength supported equities, while volatility fell to it
Rates.reason: Explicit mention that front-end Treasuries rallied after CPI relief — direct transmission into rates markets (bond rally), positive but modest relevance.

Rates.title: Japan's wholesale inflation spikes in July, bolsters rate-hike chance
Rates.reason: Higher wholesale/producer inflation in Japan raises BOJ hike odds and upward pressure on JGB yields — negative for bond prices with meaningful regional rates implications.

Rates.title: Japan’s Producer Price Gains Stay High as BOJ Mulls Rate Path
Rates.reason: Producer price strength keeps BOJ on a potentially tighter path, supporting higher JGB yields — negative for bond prices (regional rates risk).

Rates.title: (BOJ Review) Impact of the Bank of Japan's Reductions in JGB Purchases on the JGB Markets
Rates.reason: BOJ research on reduced JGB purchases highlights structural supply/central-bank flow effects that tend to lift JGB yields — a direct, policy-driven negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Japan wholesale inflation eases slightly to 7.2%, undershooting expectations
Rates.summary: The PPI reading was lower than the 7.4% expected by economists polled by Reuters, and was down from a revised 7.3% seen in June.
Rates.reason: Slight undershoot on Japan wholesale inflation is a modest counter-signal to BOJ hawkishness, supportive of lower near-term JGB yields but lower relevance compared with stronger hawkish signals.

FX.title: Euro advances against Canadian Dollar amid ECB hawkish stance, lower oil prices
FX.summary: EUR/CAD halts its six-day losing streak, trading around 1.6080 during the European hours on Thursday. The currency cross gains ground as the Euro (EUR) receives support as the macroeconomic picture in the Eurozone continues to support the European Central Bank
FX.reason: EUR strength driven by ECB hawkish tone and weaker oil (negative for CAD) directly supports EUR/CAD. Relevant FX flow for CAD/European FX, moderate relevance to USD-basket sentiment.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar extends pullback from two-month high as oil-driven Fed hike bets lift USD
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair builds on the previous day's bounce from the 1.3900 neighborhood, or a two-month low, and gains follow-through positive traction for the second straight day on Thursday.
FX.reason: Article highlights USD/CAD gains as oil-driven Fed-hike bets lift the USD. This is a USD-strength signal (negative for non-USD currencies) and directly relevant to USD flow into CAD.

FX.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Cooling NZ inflation expectations push Kiwi under pressure
FX.summary: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) underperforms its major currency peers, trading 0.45% down at around 0.5830 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Thursday.
FX.reason: FX-native NZD/USD story: cooling NZ inflation expectations are weighing on the Kiwi and supporting USD; clear USD-strength transmission into the pair.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ hike expectations support JPY against US Dollar - MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes the Japanese Yen has strengthened modestly as markets anticipate a faster pace of Bank of Japan policy tightening.
FX.reason: BoJ tightening expectations are a direct FX-native driver supporting JPY vs USD. Central-bank-driven JPY moves are highly relevant to global FX regime and intervention risk.

FX.title: Rate hike bets leave yen's post-intervention gains at BOJ's mercy
FX.reason: Headline highlights interaction of rate-hike expectations and prior intervention — signals sustained JPY sensitivity to policy and intervention risk. High relevance for FX because it speaks to potential volatility and central-bank action around USD/JPY.

FX.title: Japanese Yen holds ground due to potential intervention from Japanese authorities
FX.summary: USD/JPY inches lower after registering minor losses in the previous day, trading around 159.40 during the European hours on Thursday. The currency pair hovers near the crucial 160.00 level, keeping traders on high alert for possible intervention from Japanese
FX.reason: Article flags USD/JPY near the 160 level and explicit intervention risk — strong FX-native signal that supports JPY and raises relevance due to potential policy action.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah remains subdued as safe-haven demand lifts US Dollar
FX.summary: USD/IDR gains ground for the third consecutive day, trading around 17,920 during the early European hours on Thursday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) recovers its daily losses amid escalating geopolitical tensions between the US and Iran.
FX.reason: Safe-haven flows amid geopolitical tensions are lifting the USD and pressuring IDR (USD/IDR higher). Direct USD-centric FX transmission with clear relevance to EMFX flows.

FX.title: Indian Rupee falls as US Dollar holds gains
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens on a cautious note against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday due to overnight gains in the latter. The USD/INR pair edges up to near 95.42 after a corrective move the previous day, as fears of a prolonged global energy supply disrupt
FX.reason: USD remains firm and is pressuring INR (USD/INR higher); typical USD-driven EMFX move with moderate relevance to broader dollar strength narrative.

FX.title: Australian Dollar: Upside risk intact above 0.7025 against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann report AUD/USD briefly broke above 0.7075 to 0.7091 before retreating to close almost unchanged at 0.7063.
FX.reason: Bank note flags AUD upside versus USD (AUD/USD intra-day strength). Moderate relevance as AUD moves reflect risk/carry dynamics vs USD.

FX.title: British Pound drifts away from 1.3500 as UK GDP slows down and Industrial Production falls
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) treads water against the US Dollar (USD), trading practically flat, a few pips below the 1.3500 level on Thursday's early London session.
FX.reason: UK data weakness (slower GDP/industrial production) weighing on GBP vs USD. Direct GBP/USD implication, moderate relevance to euro‑dollar dynamics.

FX.title: Swiss Franc holds ground following domestic Producer and Import Prices data
FX.summary: USD/CHF depreciates after three days of gains, trading around 0.8130 during the European hours on Thursday. The pair holds losses as the Swiss Franc (CHF) remains stronger following Swiss Producer and Import Prices data for July.
FX.reason: CHF strength vs USD after domestic price data pushed USD/CHF lower. Direct FX-native move with moderate relevance (SNB stance also referenced elsewhere).

FX.title: Eurozone Industrial Production remains flat in June vs. -0.1% estimates
FX.summary: The Eurozone industrial sector activity remained flat in June, while it was expected to decline 0.1%, according to data published by Eurostat. In May, Industrial production contracted by 0.3%, revised lower from -0.2%.
FX.reason: IP outturn slightly better-than-expected is a small positive for EUR sentiment vs USD; modest FX relevance as a macro datapoint.

Commodities.title: Gold: Upside capped by Fed hike risks – TD Securities
Commodities.summary: TD Securities’ Bart Melek notes Gold extended gains after the July Consumer Price Index (CPI) matched expectations, reinforcing a dovish narrative around Fed Chair Warsh.
Commodities.reason: Analyst note ties gold upside to tame CPI / dovish Fed narrative (positive for bullion) but explicitly warns Fed-hike risk caps further gains. Precious-metals macro is the dominant transmission here, so bullish direction with material relevance.

Commodities.title: Where gold price is headed next as Fed rate hike and inflation odds change direction
Commodities.summary: Gold prices have been volatile in 2026, but a recent rally shows renewed investor interest amid tamer inflation data and changing Fed rate expectations.
Commodities.reason: Broad-market narrative: tamer inflation / shifting Fed odds are rekindling investor interest in gold. This is a macro driver for the commodity and therefore higher relevance and a positive direction.

Commodities.title: Gold pauses after tame US inflation fuels rally to over two-month peak
Commodities.reason: Reuters reports gold rally tied directly to tame US inflation — high-quality, market-moving confirmation of the macro precious-metals narrative. Slightly tempered by 'pause' language, but overall supportive and highly relevant.

Commodities.title: Gold languishes near daily low; eyes $4,350 amid Fed hike bets, USD strength
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) retreats over $100 from its highest level since June 5, touched earlier this Thursday, and maintains its bearish tone around the $4,375-$4,370 region through the first half of the European session.
Commodities.reason: Intraday/technical/USD-driven weakness is a valid counter-signal to the broader gold rally. Price/technical article => capped relevance (per framework) and a modest negative direction reflecting USD/fed-hike pressure.

Commodities.title: Silver prices today, Wednesday, August 12, 2026: Surpassing $66 as expectations for July inflation ease
Commodities.reason: Silver moving higher alongside easing inflation expectations — supports the broader precious-metals bullish backdrop. Pricing piece => relevance capped at 0.8 but still positive transmission to commodity prices.

Commodities.title: Brent Oil Holds Six-Day Gain With Focus on Hormuz and Deficits
Commodities.reason: Sustained Brent gains driven by Strait of Hormuz concerns and supply deficit risk are material market drivers for oil. High relevance given geopolitical supply-risk + price momentum.

Commodities.title: Oil: Supply disruptions raise deficit risks – ING
Commodities.summary: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note Oil prices have eased, with Brent crude ending largely flat as US-Iran talks remain in deadlock and Russian port infrastructure escapes major damage.
Commodities.reason: Analyst view highlighting supply disruptions and deficit risk — reinforces the oil bullish narrative. Important for price expectations, medium-high relevance.

Commodities.title: Saudi Arabia ramps up oil exports through Mediterranean pipeline to avoid attacks in Red Sea
Commodities.summary: Oil exports from Egypt's Mediterranean port of Sidi Kerir have more than doubled. The crude is mostly from Saudi Arabia, according to Kpler.
Commodities.reason: Rerouting via Mediterranean increases Saudi flows and alleviates some Red Sea transit risk — modestly negative for near-term oil risk premium. Relevant operational update for oil supply lines.

Commodities.title: Shipping giants warn ports and trucks could hold up deliveries and push up prices
Commodities.summary: Global shipping demand remains strong despite geopolitical turmoil, but port and trucking bottlenecks are increasing congestion and putting upward pressure on freight rates.
Commodities.reason: Logistics bottlenecks lift freight costs and can translate into higher commodity delivered prices; relevant cross-cutting supply-side pressure for physical commodities.

Commodities.title: United States on track for record natural gas production in 2026
Commodities.summary: We forecast U.S. marketed natural gas production will average 122.5 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in 2026, surpassing the previous record of 118.5 Bcf/d set in 2025, in our August 2026 Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO).
Commodities.reason: Record U.S. gas production raises downside risk for natural-gas prices. EIA top-level forecast is highly relevant to the gas market and signals downward price pressure.

Commodities.title: The U.S.-Canada natural gas and electricity trade value rose in 2025
Commodities.summary: Although the total value of energy trade between the United States and Canada fell by 11% in 2025 to an estimated $137 billion, according to data from the U.S. Census Bureau, the trade value of natural gas and electricity between the two countries increased sl
Commodities.reason: Higher cross-border trade value for gas/electricity indicates some demand/support for North American gas flows; limited standalone market-moving power relative to production forecasts, so low relevance and small positive.

Commodities.title: Soybeans Fall on Tuesday, with Wetter Forecasts Adding Pressure
Commodities.reason: Weather-driven bearish pressure for soybeans (wetter forecasts) directly impacts the agricultural futures in the commodity universe; reasonably high relevance for crop prices.

Commodities.title: Corn Faces Pre-USDA Report Pressure on Tuesday
Commodities.reason: Near-term price pressure ahead of USDA report is a standard crop-market dynamic; price/seasonal news with moderate relevance to corn futures.

Commodities.title: Gulf Oil Giants Are Spending Billions to Build Ways Around Strait of Hormuz
Commodities.reason: Long-term capex to bypass Hormuz could reduce future transit risk premium, a small negative for oil prices over time. Relevant but not immediate or large in magnitude.

Crypto.reason: Exploit on Harmony increases risk perception across altcoins and can trigger broader risk-off flows; BTC holding near key level is secondary. Net negative for crypto market sentiment and liquidity.

Crypto.title: One overlooked group has added $1.78 billion of selling pressure to bitcoin market

Crypto.title: Fidelity moves to add staking, quarterly payouts to near $900 million ether ETF

Crypto.title: Russia moves to restrict retail crypto trading to bitcoin, ether and USDT
Crypto.reason: Regulatory narrowing of tradable assets in a major market restricts retail access to altcoins and reduces onshore liquidity — negative for overall crypto market breadth and demand.

Crypto.title: Solana neared a freeze threshold Wednesday, Marinade Finance says. The Foundation says it held up under stress.
Crypto.reason: Near-freeze events undermine chain reliability and could reduce use-case confidence and capital allocation to Solana; notable technical risk signal for protocol-level assets.

Crypto.title: Metaplanet denies selling bitcoin worth $320 million

Crypto.title: Bitcoin firms ask AI labs for same tools attackers already have
Crypto.reason: Requests for advanced defensive AI reflect rising security threats; elevated operational risk and costs are a negative for ecosystem stability and investor confidence.

Crypto.title: Wintermute plans $1 billion AI push beyond crypto: Bloomberg
Crypto.reason: Large crypto-native firm reallocating capital toward AI suggests potential diversion of talent/capital away from crypto, a modest negative signal for sector investment flows.

Crypto.title: Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint launches Hong Kong dollar stablecoin
Crypto.reason: Institutional bank-led stablecoin issuance supports onshore fiat-crypto liquidity and payments rails — positive for market infrastructure and regional utility.

Crypto.title: National Bank Of Canada Discloses Stakes In Crypto ETFs
Crypto.reason: Disclosure of institutional stakes in crypto ETFs is a signal of continued institutional participation and demand for fund-wrapped crypto exposure — modestly positive.

Crypto.title: Strategy CEO Says Bitcoin Holdings Will Grow By Year’s End
Crypto.reason: Company-level guidance suggesting increased BTC holdings is a small positive signal for demand, but it's idiosyncratic and lower relevance to market-wide flows.

Crypto.title: Miden bets on privacy stablecoins with introduction of USDCx
Crypto.reason: Privacy-enabled stablecoin innovation can broaden use cases and appeal for certain on-chain flows; positive for stablecoin utility and niche adoption.

Crypto.title: Speculation on dogecoin is back to October 2025 levels. The price is down 70%
Crypto.reason: Sharp drawdown in a major memecoin signals speculative unwind and elevated volatility in lower-quality crypto assets; limited relevance to broad-market structural trends.
